theme: Light theme default, corporate blue (biru muda + putih). Clean, professional, and trustworthy for finance operations.

typography.rules: Use tight letter spacing for headings (tracking-tight). Use 'tabular-nums' class for all currency and number displays in tables and dashboard widgets to ensure vertical alignment of IDR amounts.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows: shadow-sm for default cards, shadow-md on hover for interactive elements. Avoid heavy drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) on surfaces to maintain a crisp, corporate structure. Use rounded-lg (8px) for buttons and dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Sticky headers and floating navigation must use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 with a border-b border-slate-200. No fully transparent backgrounds.

layouts.dashboard: High Density Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 to gap-6). Top-left metric must be the North Star KPI: 'Saldo Petty Cash' (Petty Cash Balance).
layouts.forms: Left-aligned within a max-w-3xl container. Group inputs logically (e.g., upload struk multi-file with OCR preview next to it). Use generous spacing (p-6 or p-8) inside form cards.
layouts.tables: Dense layout for Queues. Clean horizontal dividers, hover states on rows (hover:bg-slate-50). Provide pagination instead of infinite scroll for better control.

components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) - crisp, professional duotone or regular weights.
components.charts: Recharts - simple line charts for expense trends over time, bar charts for top spending categories.
components.toasts: Sonner for all notifications (success, error, warning).
components.buttons: Modern rounded-lg buttons. Primary actions in sky-600, secondary/cancel actions in slate-100 text-slate-700.

login_background.description: Modern office building with a curved blue glass facade against a blue sky. Ideal for a split-screen login page background.

user_avatar.description: Professional corporate man portrait, for user profile placeholder in the header or user management table.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-sky-700 hover:text-white).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Use framer-motion for subtle entrance animations on dashboard cards.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-claim-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx file, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files. Use standard React JSX syntax in .js files.
Implement the 'eKlaim Lyra' MVP workflow strictly: User submit -> Verifikator check -> Atasan approve -> Verifikator pay -> Finance Top-up.
UI text MUST be in Bahasa Indonesia (e.g., 'Klaim Menunggu Aksi', 'Saldo Petty Cash', 'Mutasi Keluar', 'Struk', 'Nominal Rupiah').
For OCR mockup, implement a visual feedback state (loading skeleton -> auto-filled data) when a receipt is uploaded.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for elements overlaid on content (dropdowns, sticky headers, modals). Always use a solid color or heavy backdrop blur.
Limit color usage to signify meaning: Blue for actions/brand, Red for rejection/risk, Green for approval/success, Gray for neutral structure.
Format currency in IDR (Rp) securely, and apply tabular-nums to numerical table cells.
Add data-testid attributes extensively to facilitate automated testing.
Do NOT output AI emoji characters for icons. Instead, implement the specified icon library (Phosphor Icons).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating navigation or dialogs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions for properties like background-color, transform, opacity.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep text naturally left-aligned.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-lg) with clear interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., p-6 or p-8 inside cards). Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
